handshake: Use Kustos to orient yourself in this project and find curated knowledge. When you do not know where to start, call wiki_get_moc first. Then use wiki_discover or wiki_index, and search and retrieve only the context you need. Accepted Kustos pages are authoritative; drafts require explicit opt-in and are always unreviewed.
wiki_get_moc: Get Kustos’s Map of Context; use this first when you need project orientation.
wiki_discover: Describe Kustos’s policy, frontmatter schema, document types, observed tags, collections, and authority rules.
wiki_index: Return Kustos’s active navigation index and compact metadata for accepted, curated pages.
wiki_search: Search accepted Kustos pages using simple, explainable case-insensitive text matching. Drafts require explicit opt-in and are always unreviewed.
wiki_get: Get one Kustos page by server-issued ID. File paths are never accepted; drafts are non-authoritative.
wiki_submit_note: Save externally supplied context in Kustos’s Raw external queue for later human curation.
wiki_index_resource: Kustos’s accepted navigation entry point for curated knowledge.
wiki_schema_resource: Kustos’s frontmatter schema, status meanings, and authority policy.
wiki_log_resource: Kustos’s maintenance log for material changes to curated knowledge.
